Read `REQUIREMENTS.md`, then `DESIGN.md`; requirements override design. Do not implement based on independent judgment; ask user if undocumented. Report contradictions to user and request confirmation. Check `package.json`; analyze error messages.

TypeScript 5.x strict; Svelte 5.x runes (`$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`); Vite 5.x; Biome 1.x; Go WebAssembly; UI English; packages `go/ast`, `go/parser`, `go/token`; Svelte Writable Store; stores `astStore`, `parseErrorStore`, `selectedNodeStore`, `expandedNodesStore`. Use `vite-plugin-singlefile`; inline all JS/CSS/WASM binaries. Go AST only; use go/parser.

Enable strict mode; explicitly write type definitions; avoid magic numbers, use constants; single responsibility; explicitly type props; BEM recommended; global styles in `src/styles/global.css`; component styles in `<style>`.

MUST convention: Prohibit redundant comments (no explanation needed for simple operations)
SHOULD convention: Write comments where code intent is hard to convey
MUST convention: Write commit messages in English
MUST convention: Write Pull Request titles and descriptions in English
MUST convention: Add GPG sign to all commits
MUST convention: Add Claude as Co-Author:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Co-Authored-By: Claude <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>
MUST convention: Run `npm run lint` before committing
MUST convention: Run `npm run type-check` before committing
If either command exits with an error, fix the issues before committing
Lint errors: Run `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting issues
Type errors: Fix type mismatches in the reported files
